overview_description.description:
Virool was acquired by Turgo. In its history, Virool has raised over $20 million from renowned investors including Y-Combinator, Draper Fisher Juvertson, Menlo Ventures, 500 Startups and Yahoo!
More than 30,000 global advertisers used the Virool platform to promote their video messages, engage their audience, and elevate their brand. More than 100,000 online and mobile publisher properties have run video content from Virool via programmatic partnerships, native placements, and direct integrations. Virool was trusted by some of the biggest brands in the world, including Coca-Cola, Red Bull, Disney, Sony, Anheuser-Busch, Turkish Airlines, Intel, and Levi's. 

Virool was founded in 2012 and raised $6.62M in seed funding from a collection of top VC firms and angel investors. It was the biggest seed investment that any Y-Combinator graduate has ever received.

about_short_description.short_description: Virool is a programmatic video marketing platform that helps brands engage audiences with targeted, native video placements.

product.name: Programmatic Video Distribution Platform
product.description: A platform that distributes video advertisements programmatically across a network of publishers with advanced targeting and real-time analytics.

product.name: InLine Native Video Unit
product.description: An outstream video ad unit that embeds video natively within editorial content on desktop and mobile web, activating only when in view.

product.name: eIQ Emotional Insights Technology
product.description: A tool that measures and analyzes viewers' emotional responses to video content in real-time using webcam-based emotion tracking.
